findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_phone, p1_practice_deck · Private data: verify_phone, tendeck_help, connectors_catalog · Public sink: start_workspace, verify_phone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_phone, p1_practice_deck · Private data: verify_phone, tendeck_help, connectors_catalog · Public sink: start_workspace, verify_phone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
